rejected: {"action_goal": "直接继续写代码，不处理已发现的误区。", "confidence": 0.82, "event_intent": "PRACTICE", "evidence_refs": ["page-4-006"], "reason_summary": "先纠正已观察误区，再进入练习。", "state_delta": {"diagnosis_label": "misconception", "hint_level": 1, "student_state_label": "scaffold"}, "stop_condition": "学生说明关键检查点后继续。"}
